title: Re-export comment explains effect but not rationale for placement in config.rs
description:
crates/imap/src/config.rs lines 4-5:
  /// Re-export the shared credential type so callers within this crate
  /// can import it from crate::config without depending on stoa-auth directly.

The comment explains what the re-export does (effect) but not why it lives in config.rs rather than lib.rs (rationale). A future maintainer will reasonably ask:

1. stoa_auth::UserCredential is already a top-level re-export from stoa_auth::lib.rs. So the full short path is already stoa_auth::UserCredential; there is no need to go through stoa_auth::config::UserCredential. Why re-export from config.rs rather than imap/src/lib.rs?

2. The comment says 'without depending on stoa-auth directly' but imap already depends on stoa_auth for CredentialStore. The stated benefit does not apply.

The comment should be updated to accurately explain the actual rationale (or removed if the re-export is moved to lib.rs per the companion elegance issue).

File: crates/imap/src/config.rs lines 4-6.
